messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: Error with Data Input?
parts:
Hi Low,
You need to run that from your R console.

Please make sure you have the latest version of shinyapps, to install: devtools::install_github("rstudio/shinyapps")   .  You should then be able to run the following R command:  shinyapps::showLogs()

Hope this helps.
-Tareef
